meta.name: pre-publish-review
meta.description: Nuclear-grade 16-agent pre-publish release gate. Runs /get-unpublished-changes to detect all changes since last npm release, spawns up to 10 ultrabrain agents for deep per-change analysis, invokes /review-work (5 agents) for holistic review, and 1 oracle for overall release synthesis. Use before EVERY npm publish. Triggers: 'pre-publish review', 'review before publish', 'release review', 'pre-release review', 'ready to publish?', 'can I publish?', 'pre-publish', 'safe to publish', 'publishing review', 'pre-publish check'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在 npm 发布前自动审查所有变更
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次 npm 发布前都想自动检查变更并确保质量
copy.tagline_en: Automatically review all changes before npm publish
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want automated change review before every npm publish

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会在你每次发布 npm 包前，自动检测所有未发布的更改，并启动最多 16 个智能体进行深度审查，最后给出是否可发布的综合评估。
howto.when: 当你提到“pre-publish review”、“review before publish”、“release review”等关键词，或要求检查是否可以发布时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一次发布前审查。
say.note: Claude 会启动所有审查流程。

say.text: 检查一下现在可以发布吗？
say.note: Claude 会运行完整审查并给出结论。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will automatically detect all unpublished changes before every npm publish, spawn up to 16 agents for deep review, and provide a final release readiness assessment.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'pre-publish review', 'review before publish', 'release review', or ask if it's safe to publish.

say_en.note: Claude will start all review processes.

say_en.text: Check if I can publish now.
say_en.note: Claude will run the full review and give a verdict.
